camel_example: aliyun ice DropSearchIndex --region cn-hangzhou --IndexType mm --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Deletes a specific type of index and its existing index data in a specified search library. After the deletion, newly added media assets are no longer analyzed, stored, or searched by using this type of index
description_zh: 删除指定搜索库中某类索引及其存量索引数据。删除后，新增媒资不再进行该类索引的分析、存储和搜索
name: DropSearchIndex

parameters.help_en:
The name of the search library.

If you do not specify the search library name, the search index is created in the default search library of Intelligent Media Services (IMS) by default. Default value: ims-default-search-lib.
You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html operation to query existing search libraries
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库名称。

未填写搜索库名称时，默认情况下搜索索引会被创建在IMS的默认搜索库下。默认值ims-default-search-lib。
您还可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html接口查询已有的搜索库信息
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the index. Valid values:
mm: large model.
face: face.
aiLabel: smart tag
parameters.help_zh:
索引类别。取值：
mm：大模型。
face：人脸。
aiLabel：智能标签
parameters.name: index_type

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
